name: smwgraphics-valis-the-fantasm-soldier-yuko-asou
title: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier - Yuko Asou
description:
Submitted during Winter C3 2023!

Yuko Asou, the heroine from the well-known Valis video game series, arrives to Super Mario World—and she's ready to face off against the forces of darkness! This fully-featured player set includes all poses for each powerup state, as well as cutscenes and the overworld. Uses only vanilla Mario (and Luigi) palettes, so no need to install custom global palettes when using!

Made by ValisEmma of The Spriters Resource and ported by yours truly for ROM hacking use.
